pipoco:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent 2D animation spritesheet for Horda Zumbi, a polished side-scrolling spooky cartoon mobile game. ONE single original zombie bird character named PIPOCO, a hilariously FAT round lime-green undead pigeon, tiny orange beak with one little crooked tooth, enormous amber eyes with dark purple pupils, dark violet eyebrows and a tiny disheveled purple feather tuft, small purple wings, little orange feet, a ragged plum scarf and stitched belly. Extremely appealing, silly, greedy and cuddly, not gory. Strong dark plum outlines, richly shaded hand-painted cartoon sprite art, highly readable silhouette, matches cute green zombies with purple shirts. Head and belly form one round pear shape, no humanoid body. He looks like he ate far too much and his tiny wings barely carry him.
SPRITE SHEET REQUIREMENTS: landscape 1536x1024 canvas, exact uniform THREE columns by TWO rows of square 512x512 cells, SIX full-body isolated sprites of the SAME character at SAME scale and center of mass in each cell. No visible grid, no labels, no frames, no background, genuine transparent alpha. Leave transparent padding inside every cell. All sprites face RIGHT in near-side profile with a slight 3/4 view for expressive eyes.
Top row: three coherent looping flying keyframes: wings raised fully, wings extended level, wings flapping downward; same body shape and face. Bottom row: three personality/action keyframes: content sleepy blink with puffed cheeks; startled with huge eyes and feet tucked up; excited greedy open-beak cheer, wings raised and belly squashed slightly. No props or loose particles in the sheet. Feet stay attached, wings anatomically attached, no duplicates or extra limbs. Keep every sprite completely within its own cell. This is a brand new original bird, not any existing Zombie Tsunami pet.
